response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack/web engineer with strong TypeScript, Node.js, and D language skills, but is a poor match for this embedded networking security role. He lacks the required native-level Japanese proficiency, has no demonstrated Linux kernel investigation/modification experience, no security or networking protocol background (MACsec, 802.1X, SNMP/NETCONF), and only brief C/C++ exposure from a six-month role in 2014-2015. The core mandatory requirements are not met.
strengths: Long, varied software engineering career (15+ years) with strong Linux familiarity
Some low-level/systems experience (C/C++ at National Instruments, low-latency DLang services, hardware work with robotic arms)
Strong engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, open-source contributions, and teaching/mentoring
concerns: No Japanese language proficiency, which is a hard requirement (native-level)
No embedded networking, security protocol (MACsec, 802.1X), or Linux kernel modification experience
C proficiency for UNIX development is minimal and dated; career centers on web/full-stack work

key_factors.factor: No embedded security/networking or kernel experience
